coverage.evidence: MusicTemplateHelpers.cs:37-43 registers every row of the music groups (MusicGroups.All, lines 80-91): MusicConfigHelpers.cs:20-35 (3), MusicQueueHelpers.cs:20-86 (9), MusicNowHelpers.cs:18-42 (8), MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:20-44 (6), MusicProgressHelpers.cs:18-38 (5), MusicQueuePlaceHelpers.cs:24-117 (9), MusicHistoryHelpers.cs:23-83 (8). That is 48, and the 6 pipeline values at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:790-813 make 54, the same as the page. Rows with arguments: music.queue.item and music.queue.list take args:1 (MusicQueueHelpers.cs:50,63), music.history.list takes args:1 (MusicHistoryHelpers.cs:38), music.now.bar takes maxArgs:1 (MusicProgressHelpers.cs:38). MusicRow.cs:162-165 prints a row as written when the argument count is wrong.

MusicText.cs:27-33 gives the title alone when there is no artist. MusicText.cs:22-24 sets the bar to 11 marks by default and allows a width of 1 to 50, and lists up to 20. MusicProgressHelpers.cs:41-56 gives only the bar when a width is set (bar:5 at 40% gives two marks, the knob, two marks, per MusicText.cs:55-61). MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:47-62 gives the five status states and off, track or context for repeat. MusicConfigHelpers.cs:25-29 shows MaxRequestsPerUser only, and MusicConfigDtos.cs:89-96 with MusicService.cs:1884-1896 show that a role cap is a separate map (MaxRequestsPerRole). MusicQueueHelpers.cs:82-86 sums item.Cost, and MusicService.cs:1284-1285 sets Cost: 0 for every live request, so the result is 0 (StreamText.cs:30).

TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22 Standard is every context except Viewer (Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook; TemplateHelperContext.cs:21-63). WithTriggerViewer at TemplateHelperContexts.cs:32-38 is Command, EventResponse, Pipeline and Webhook. MusicRow.cs:144-153 uses Standard by default and ForViewer narrows a row to WithTriggerViewer. TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:50-60 makes the playlist and favorite values pipeline only. TemplateResolver.cs:124-127 and 155-156 refuse any helper outside the Viewer context in viewer text.

MusicRow.cs:59-72 returns null (printed as written) when no track plays. MusicRow.cs:75-88 treats an empty queue as a real answer: length is 0 (MusicQueueHelpers.cs:21), requesters is 0 (65-76), isEmpty is true (78-81). duration, next and list return null when the queue is empty (22-29, 30-34, 52-64). MusicNowHelpers.cs:31,44 returns null for a blank album or requester. MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:20-30 means isPlaying and status always answer.

MusicData.cs:49 sets HistoryWindow = 500, and MusicData.cs:177-187 reads the newest 500 records (MusicHistoryReader.cs:41-48). SongRequestPlayedHistoryWriter.cs:73-95 turns a pending row into a counted row when the song plays and sets CreatedAt to the play time. MusicHistoryHelpers.cs:89-101 filters the stream values to WentLiveAt and gives null when offline. MusicData.cs:205-221 reads music.user.requests.total from the viewer profile TotalSongRequests.

SongRequestFavoriteAction.cs:51 sets CandidateLimit to 10, and lines 208-215 sort most-requested first. Lines 124-129 give none with an empty track when there is no history. Lines 144-147 give queued. Lines 150-160 give unavailable and keep the track. Lines 164-166 give none with the first candidate when all are refused. Lines 240-243 set the four values in ctx.Variables, with count 0 when there is no track. PlaylistAddAction.cs:173-178 puts playlist_id and track_name (track_name falls back to track_uri for a fixed track) only into a local seed used for message and already_message (lines 213-224, 245-252).

reader_answers.evidence: music.now and music.queue.next exist (MusicNowHelpers.cs:19-23, MusicQueueHelpers.cs:30-34). The rows with arguments are bar, item, list and history.list (MusicProgressHelpers.cs:38, MusicQueueHelpers.cs:50,63, MusicHistoryHelpers.cs:38). The request settings are open, maxDuration and maxPerUser (MusicConfigHelpers.cs:21-34). The player settings are volume, shuffle and repeat (MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:33-35).

Standard contexts are at TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22. Now-playing rows read IMusicService.GetNowPlayingAsync (MusicData.cs:157-162, MusicRow.cs:59-72). Config and history rows read saved settings and stored records (MusicData.cs:177-196). The favorite and playlist values are pipeline only (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:50-60, SongRequestFavoriteAction.cs:240-243, PlaylistAddAction.cs:173-178).

A null render prints as written (MusicRow.cs:72, 162-165). isPlaying gives false when there is no track (MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:25). status always maps to five states (MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:47-55). An empty queue gives length 0, requesters 0 and isEmpty true, while next and list give null (MusicQueueHelpers.cs:21, 30-34, 52-81).

music.now gives 'Song A by Artist A' and null with no track (MusicNowHelpers.cs:19-23, MusicRow.cs:72). music.queue.next is null when the queue is empty, while length gives 0 and isEmpty gives true (MusicQueueHelpers.cs:21, 30-34, 78-81). PeopleText.Flag gives true or false for if and switch (MusicPlayerHelpers.cs:25).
